messages:
Maria G: Heads-up — procurement just shared revised lead times from vendors. H200 quoted at 12-16 weeks for new orders, H100 backorders extended to 8-12 weeks. L40S availability is immediate but supply is limited for chassis configs.

Aj: Oof. That pushes Q3 capacity plans. Do we have updated GPU-hour projections per region?

Maria G: Quick summary from the forecasting sheet: US-W 38k GPU-hrs/wk current, EU 14k, APAC 9k. We expect baseline growth ~10-15% month-over-month; marketing/holiday promos can double spikes for short bursts.

Sam T: For Q3-Q4 planning we should separate steady-state demand vs burst capacity. Steady-state can use L40S or H100 quantized profiles; bursts we prefer H200/H100 for latency-sensitive chat workloads.

Aj: Quick calc I ran locally:
```
current_weekly = 38000
monthly_growth = 0.12
weeks_to_q3 = 9
proj_weekly = int(current_weekly * (1+monthly_growth)**(weeks_to_q3/4))
# => ~55-60k GPU-hrs/wk
```
So we need ~45-60% more steady GPU-hours by the start of Q3 if growth holds.

Liam: Two procurement levers: 1) place reservation POs for a portion of H200s now (long lead, better throughput per card); 2) top up with L40S to handle embedding-heavy traffic at lower cost. Also consider short-term cloud reserved instances for APAC until on-prem gear arrives.

procurement-bot: Vendor update: VendorA can hold pricing for 30 days; VendorB requires 50% deposit to lock H200 slots.

Maria G: Important: rack power and cooling in our EU colo limits dense H200 packing. We might need an extra rack or spread H200s across two sites. That affects colo contracts and cross-region failover.

Sam T: Network-wise, adding >200 TFLOP cards per rack increases East-West traffic for KV cache fetches. Need to budget aggregate network egress and check ToR spine oversubscription. infra-bot can run a quick snapshot?

infra-bot: Running cluster network utilization snapshot for last 30 days... Summary sent to #eng-infra-private. Peak inter-rack traffic increased 28% during promos; 90th percentile latency to model shards stable at 2.6ms.

Aj: Risk checklist: vendor lead times, rack power, APAC supply, cost delta H200 vs L40S, and contract terms (refunds/delivery SLAs). Also quota requests to cloud partners for short-term bursts.

Maria G: Proposal: split procurement across three buckets — A) reserve 40% of projected incremental need as H200 (place POs now, stagger delivery), B) 40% as L40S (fast delivery, cheaper for high-throughput inference), C) 20% on short-term cloud reserved capacity for bursts and APAC coverage. Ask procurement to negotiate staggered deliveries and penalty clauses.

Liam: I'll open a ticket with colo for extra rack options and power upgrade quotes. If we can't get additional rack density, shift more H200 to US-East and use L40S in EU.

Sam T: Also recommend testing H100->H200 performance delta on our common prompt suite before we commit full reservations. If H100 with quantization meets latency, we can reduce H200 orders.

Aj: Can procurement-bot share vendor deposit deadlines and minimum order quantities? We should lock any PO decisions by EOW to hit Q3 arrival windows.

procurement-bot: Vendor deadlines: VendorA price hold expires in 28 days; VendorB requires deposit within 10 business days to secure next H200 batch. MOQ for VendorB is 16 cards per order.

Maria G: OK — action items: (1) Sam/Liam run perf + power feasibility tests this week, (2) Aj update forecast with conservative + upside scenarios and present by Thu, (3) Procurement to draft staggered PO options and deposit terms.

Aj: I'll update the forecast and ping finance for preliminary budget sign-off. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Sam T: I'll start perf runs on H100 and L40S images and post results here.

Liam: I'll get colo quotes and check APAC vendor channels.

Maria G: Thanks — let's reconvene Fri morning for a go/no-go on deposits. :thumbsup:
